decision.meaning: Keep the existing hover-start approach. Do not implement the click-start completion proposal.

observations: All seven runs passed the same dependent-choice flow, keep/clear policy, save, single Undo/Redo and YAML reload. One run added logging only to an owned installed test copy; six used the unchanged VSIX.
Passive browser traces captured real trusted pointer/mouse entry into the hover frame; no synthetic events or product UI state mutation were used.
Non-pausing debugger logpoints captured close and result-clear decisions in the owned renderer. Observed close calls came from editor commands after selection; recorded boundary entry was retained.
The inspected runtime hover settings were enabled:on, sticky:true, hidingDelay:300. Settings were read, not modified.

Extension-side logging run measured apply acknowledgements 17..28ms and close-command acknowledgements 1..18ms. The next menu observation was 424ms or more after the previous close returned. No late close was observed in that run; unrecorded prior failures remain unexplained.
The extension-logging run recorded document focus true and no window blur/visibility transition. Do not infer that prior unrecorded runs had the same focus state.
Slower 40ms-per-step motion passed with debugger tracing and without any extra event/debugger/source instrumentation. The normal 8ms cases also passed.
Instrumentation can affect timing; passing instrumented runs is not a fix. The uninstrumented control was therefore retained separately.
